name: Tsintaosaurus
sum: A hadrosaurid of the Late Cretaceous of China, about 8.3 m long, whose supposed nasal horn has been reinterpreted.
wsnote: About 8.3 m long in the Wikipedia revision used.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; named by Young in 1958 from Laiyang, Shandong.
material: Not read in the sources consulted beyond the holotype.
biology: Not described in the sources consulted.
author: Young 1958
